title: Dark Chocolate Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: Melted dark chocolate, cocoa and a little coffee replace the strawberries, with more milk and less cream.
summary: A deep, intense chocolate ice cream from 70% chocolate and cocoa, with a little coffee to make the chocolate taste darker rather than of coffee.

ingredients.item: dark chocolate (about 70% cocoa solids), finely chopped
light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cocoa milk
steps.text: Whisk the cocoa with a splash of the milk in the saucepan to a smooth paste, then whisk in the rest of the milk, the sugar, syrup, salt and coffee. Bring just to a simmer, whisking.

steps.title: Melt the chocolate
steps.text: Pour the hot cocoa milk over the chopped chocolate in the heatproof bowl, wait 1 min, then whisk until glossy and smooth.

steps.title: Add the cream
steps.text: Whisk in the cold cream and vanilla, which also starts the cooling. Chill for at least 4 h; the base thickens noticeably.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-30 min. Chocolate bases set quickly, so stop as soon as it holds soft peaks.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container, cover and freeze for at least 4 h. Soften for 10-15 min before scooping, as chocolate ice cream freezes harder.

tips: Leave out the coffee if serving to children; the flavour will be a little milder.
Chop the chocolate finely so it melts completely in the hot milk.
Soften this one slightly longer than most; it sets firm.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
